_schemaNotes: generator: path of the in-repo script that produces the family, or null.
generatorEverExisted: whether ANY in-repo generator existed at ANY point in git history (verified via full-history scripts/ listing).
authorship: 'in-repo-script' | 'unknown'. Never guess between hand-written and off-repo generation.
firstIntroduced: commit that added the family.
modifiedSinceIntroduction: whether any family file changed after its introducing commit.
consumptionNote: how consumers reach the family, where URL-construction hides literal references.
Extension rule: future fixture families APPEND an entry with the same fields; unknown values are recorded as "unknown", never speculated.
